ShapeScale: Optical 3D Body Scanning for Body Fat Percentage, Lean Mass, and Appendicular Lean Mass Estimation

articles.summary: ShapeScale uses advanced 3D body scanning and AI to estimate visceral fat with strong agreement to DXA, without radiation or costly imaging. This enables fast, safe, and repeatable monitoring of cardiometabolic health in clinical, fitness, and consumer settings.
